description: This file contains the definition of the FormulaParser class, which is responsible for parsing Excel formulas into tokens for further processing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: FormulaParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing Excel formulas into a sequence of tokens for evaluation or further analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the FormulaParser class with a formula string, and parses it into tokens.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a specific token by its ID.

methods.name: getTokenCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tokens parsed from the formula.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Returns the list of all tokens parsed.

methods.name: parseToTokens
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual parsing of the formula string into tokens.
